notes.title: Update & Bug Fixes Released!
notes.content:
We’ve just rolled out an update! The issue with the door and trigger color mismatch at 95% completion has been fixed, allowing players to smoothly progress through that stage.

Additionally, we’ve made some balance adjustments. Players will now gain an extra life after every 5 deaths, with a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 10 lives. This update aims to keep the difficulty balanced.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: The Great Awakening Update – A New Dawn in Rooster Tale!
notes.content: Hey there, rooster wranglers! We’re thrilled to present our biggest update yet for Rooster Tale! This update brings a feathered revolution with new gameplay mechanics, more challenges, and enhanced visuals to elevate your rooster’s journey to new heights. Join us as we crow our way to the ultimate rooster adventure!
